title: Branch wizard
description: A compact export setup preserves decisions as its panels move forward and back.
useCase: Break a small configuration task into focused, reversible steps.
interaction: Name the collection, choose a format and quality, review, and prepare the local preview.
reducedMotion: Step changes appear immediately. Validation, retained values and focus movement remain available.
limitations: Local configuration preview; no files are generated.
look: Pale grey-blue page with a white bordered card holding a numbered three-step rail, outlined format tiles, a select row and a navy primary button.
motion: Changing step remounts the panel, fading it in as it slides 8 px from the right going forward or left going back, over 200 ms ease-out.
adapt: Transitions are the `wizard-w2` keyframes on `.step` (`.2s ease-out`), re-run by the `key` on step change; `go` sets `direction`, which becomes the `--travel` offset (`direction * 8` px). Replace the three step bodies, `name` validation and the export summary.
